name: focus
description: next-steps' suggested prompts above the prompt (press a number to draft one), explain buttons after a long reply (simpler, example, where it fits), time on task, today's wins and parked thoughts; a Focus pane with the plan, the next action, parked thoughts and a recap; bundles the i-have-adhd writing rules

adhdRules.title: ADHD writing rules
adhdRules.description: Add the i-have-adhd writing rules to every session: lead with the next action, numbered steps, no preamble, and a closing Next: line the band pins

minAnswerChars.title: Shortest answer to suggest after
minAnswerChars.description: Skip next-steps' suggestions after answers shorter than this many characters.

suggestSkills.title: Suggest skills and slash commands
suggestSkills.description: Tell the suggester which skills and slash commands this session has, so a suggestion can be one of them.
